sentence: The author then asked for "an extremely pluriform ars poetica bundle to gather with the others for the next ea-corpora. include telepathic prose", for Ovid entire, for Language writing and the contemporary arts of poetry as wanted, for the experimental, Dada and Surrealist statements of method, and for the bundle to go "further globally, hebrew, sanskrit, korean - this will be the single widest ranging ea corpora deposit", with "Tradition and the Individual Seismograph" beside Eliot's essay.
